secrets.name: JWT_SECRET_KEY
secrets.description: Secret used to sign JWT auth tokens. Auto-generated for development; replace with your own for production.

secrets.name: APP_ENCRYPTION_KEY
secrets.description: Fernet key for field-level encryption of sensitive health data. Auto-generated for development; replace with your own for production.

secrets.name: OPENAI_API_KEY
secrets.description: OpenAI API key for the AI Coach feature. Optional — if unset, the coach falls back to a deterministic template responder. Get it from https://platform.openai.com/api-keys.
